# Aastha Chopra

> Aastha Chopra is a Dubai-based luxury fashion and beauty content creator and practising lawyer. She is a UAE Media Council licensed creator (permit 1557678) with 51,000+ Instagram followers (@aastha_sochic), creating fashion, premium beauty, luxury travel, dining, and wellness content from Dubai, United Arab Emirates. She partners with premium brands across the Gulf and globally.

Key facts:
- Based in: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aastha_sochic/ (51,000+ followers)
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@aastha_c8
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@aastha_sochic
- Profession: Practising lawyer and licensed content creator
- Content pillars: fashion & beauty, luxury & travel, wellness & fitness
- 110+ brand collaborations across fashion, beauty, and fragrance
- Audience: strongest in the UAE, with India and the US following
- Business email: aasthac8@gmail.com
